## Quality Checklist

Before submitting, ensure:

- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes (ESLint + Prettier)
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes (TypeScript strict)
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (all tests)
- [ ] `pnpm test:coverage` shows 70%+ coverage (60% for UI)
- [ ] `pnpm build` succeeds
- [ ] Commit messages follow format: `type(scope): description`
- [ ] No `any` types (or commented why)
- [ ] No `console.log` in production code
- [ ] README updated if API changed
- [ ] New packages have README.md
